description: Telangana will set up special minority degree colleges in 10 district headquarters with AI and skill-based training. The move places employability, student support and wider minority welfare at the centre of the state's plan.
body_lead: Telangana to open minority degree colleges in 10 districts with AI focus Telangana will set up special minority degree colleges in 10 district headquarters with AI and skill-based training. The move places employability, student support and wider minority welfare at the centre of the state's plan. The Government of Telangana has announced a major initiative aimed at strengthening higher education opportunities for minority communities across the state.
